additional_info.body:
Hello,
I will take care of this ticket for now.
From the logs, the number appears to be correct. I can see that the vehicle charged for nearly 1 hour and 15 minutes at 300 kW, going from 61% SOC to 100%. Do you know what type of vehicle this is?
The data was correctly sent to the OCPP backend, and from what I can see, the amount seems accurate. Is the customer complaining about this amount?
Mit freundlichen Grüßen/ Best regards,Francois WINCKEL
